title: kramastotra — kram-p14-v14
question: Making sequence-swelling on that ground, measuring difference of own powers — O god, You show always in own self. Then, named doing-knowing-willing, maintenance-dissolution-great-emission-powered, three-formed — may I become, for overlying, eager-hearted.
